features: Swing-proof & 44 LB Load: Unlike other door organizers, our product features reinforced stitching between each side pocket, and built-in strengthened side cardboards to prevent tilting. Additionally, strongly reinforced bottom cardboard, which can stay put without deforming even when you load up to 44 lbs. Also, do not move/sway when you open or close the door.

Double Your Storage Space: Featuring 5 roomy pockets (up to 15.7" /40cm long) and 5 additional mesh side pockets, this over the door stuffed animal storage instantly expands storage options, making it an ideal space maximizer for any room.

Multipurpose door storage: Versatile hanging door organizer works great for expanding storage. Fits children's rooms, storage rooms, offices, laundry rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, living rooms, pantries, dorms, nurseries, and other areas where you need to store toys, diapers, wet wipes, baby towels, socks, and other items. Designed to cater to all your storage needs.

Easy Accessibility with Bigger Pockets: Sized at 15.7in L x 5.5in W x 57.8 H, our closet door organizers provide larger bins and 4.3" gaps for effortless access. The see-through mesh on each pocket ensures you find what you need effortlessly.

Easy to Assemble: Set up the toy storage organizer in a mere 30 seconds. Simply hang the hook on the door, hang the organizer onto the hooks, and insert the 5 bottom cardboards. With special metal hooks designed to fit doors up to 1.98" thick, enjoy a hassle-free and versatile installation experience.
